title: Hybrid photovoltaic–thermal solar energy system: simulation and experimental benchmark code
description: Python and C source for a three-node transient model of a water-cooled photovoltaic-thermal (PV/T) collector. Includes the controlled pure-water simulation (dry and cooled comparison, open-rack dry reference, flow-rate sweep with a pump law, conservation and refinement checks), scripts that regenerate the paper's simulation figures and audit values, and a conditional experimental benchmark that fits and tests an adapted three-state model on published five-second water–glycol PV/T measurements (DOI 10.57739/3720). A weather-driven variant of the identified model estimates the cooling benefit on the measured collector under 58 days of measured weather. The measurement data are not redistributed.
